summary.overview: Relay is a three-service pipeline joined only by a RabbitMQ bus. A Go intake API accepts scans from couriers' handhelds and publishes delivery.scanned; a Python router consumes it, records the route in its own PostgreSQL database, appends to a finance-owned ledger database and publishes delivery.routed; a Node notifier consumes that and sends an SMS through an external provider. The @relay/contracts library holds the topic names and payload types but is not deployed. Mailpit and the json-server SMS mock are development conveniences and are not modelled.
findings: The topic names are redeclared in three languages (`intake/internal/bus/publisher.go:12`, `router/router/bus.py:8-9`) instead of taken from `contracts/src/index.ts:1-2`; only the notifier imports the contracts, so a rename in one place silently breaks the pipeline.

The router writes to its routes database, then the ledger, then publishes, with no transaction across them (`router/router/main.py:10-13`); a failure after the ledger append leaves a charge without a delivery.routed message, and a redelivery appends the ledger entry twice.

The consume loops ack only after the work (`router/router/main.py:21`, `notifier/src/index.ts:17`) so delivery is at-least-once, but nothing is idempotent: a redelivered routed message sends a second SMS.

The ledger belongs to another team yet its connection is a plain URL read from LEDGER_URL (`router/router/ledger.py:15`); an outage or schema change there fails every parcel, since the append is on the critical path before publishing (`router/router/main.py:12`).
The notifier acks nothing on SMS failure and throws (`notifier/src/sms.ts:12-14`), so the consumer's callback rejects without a nack or dead-letter.
recommendations: Generate or import the topic names from `contracts` in the Go and Python services so the contract has one source.
Make the router's ledger append idempotent (key on reference) and consider an outbox so database writes and the publish succeed or fail together.
Add a retry/dead-letter policy for the notifier and deduplicate by route_id before texting.
